'''Edmund Ryszard Puczyłowski''' (born 13 February 1948 in Gorczyca,<ref name="wup">''Contemporary Polish Scientists: A Biographical Dictionary. Volume III. M-R'', published by the Information Processing Centre, Warsaw 2000, p. 603</ref> died 19 October 2021)<ref name="PTM Obituary">{{Cite web | url = https://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/zmar%C5%82-profesor-edmund-puczy%C5%82owski-1948-2021 | title = Professor Edmund Puczyłowski Passed Away | publisher = ptm.org.pl | access-date = 22 October 2021}}</ref><ref>Obituary in MIM UW [http://nekrologi.wyborcza.pl/0,11,,524920,Edmund-Puczy%C5%82owski-kondolencje.html]</ref> was a Polish [[mathematician]] and a professor of mathematical sciences. He specialized in [[algebra]] (including areas such as [[ring theory]]). He was a [[full professor]] at the Institute of Mathematics, Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics, and Mechanics of the University of Warsaw (Department of Algebra and Number Theory) and served as the director of the Institute from 2012 to 2015.{{r|ln}}<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://usosweb.uw.edu.pl/kontroler.php?_action=katalog2/osoby/pokazOsobe&os_id=444 | title = prof. dr hab. Edmund Puczyłowski | publisher = usosweb.uw.edu.pl | access-date = 18 June 2016 }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.mimuw.edu.pl/osoba/444 | title = prof. dr hab. Edmund Puczyłowski | publisher = mimuw.edu.pl | access-date = 14 July 2016 }}{{Dead link|date=August 2025 |bot=InternetArchiveBot |fix-attempted=yes }}</ref>

== Biography ==
Puczyłowski completed his studies in mathematics at the University of Warsaw in 1972. From 1972 to 1975, he pursued doctoral studies at the same university.<ref name="wup" /> In 1975, he defended his doctoral dissertation under the supervision of Adam Suliński<ref>[https://www.mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=214242 ''Mathematics Genealogy Project: Edmund Puczyłowski'']</ref> and was employed at the University of Warsaw as a senior assistant and, starting in 1977, as an assistant professor. In 1985, he obtained his habilitation degree, and in 1986, he became an associate professor. In 1991, he was appointed an extraordinary professor.<ref name="wup" /> He was awarded the title of professor of mathematical sciences in 1995.<ref name="ln">{{Polish scientists|56593|person=prof. dr hab. Edmund Ryszard Puczyłowski|access-date=19 July 2016}}</ref> He was a faculty member of the Faculty of Mathematics, Informatics, and Mechanics of the University of Warsaw, serving as the director of the Institute of Mathematics from 2012 to 2015.<ref name="PTM Obituary" />

He was a member of the [[Polish Mathematical Society]] and the scientific council of the [[Institute of Mathematics of the Polish Academy of Sciences]].<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.impan.pl/en/institute/scientific-council | title = Scientific Council | publisher = impan.pl | access-date = 19 July 2016}}</ref> From 1998 to 2007, he chaired the main committee of the [[Mathematical Olympiad]].<ref>{{Cite web | url = http://www.om.edu.pl/stara_wersja/archiwum/2003_10_17/komitet_glowny.html | title = Main Committee of the Mathematical Olympiad | publisher = om.edu.pl | access-date = 19 July 2016 | archive-url = https://web.archive.org/web/20160816125219/http://www.om.edu.pl/stara_wersja/archiwum/2003_10_17/komitet_glowny.html | archive-date = 16 August 2016}}</ref><ref name="PTM Obituary" />

He published his works in journals such as [[Proceedings of the American Mathematical Society]]*, Journal of Algebra and Its Applications, Journal of Pure and Applied Algebra, and Archiv der Mathematik.<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.mimuw.edu.pl/publikacje/?tryb=o&id_osoby=444 | title = Edmund Puczyłowski (publications) | publisher = mimuw.edu.pl | access-date = 13 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url = https://scholar.google.pl/scholar?q=author%3A%22ER+Puczy%C5%82owski%22 | title = Edmund Puczyłowski (publications and citations) | publisher = scholar.google.pl | access-date = 14 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url = http://bibliografia.icm.edu.pl/g2/main.pl?mod=s&a=1&s=4684&imie=Edmund&nazwisko=Puczy%B3owski | title = Edmund Puczyłowski (publications) | publisher = bibliografia.icm.edu.pl | access-date = 14 July 2016}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web | url = https://pbn.nauka.gov.pl/sedno-webapp/persons/1739386/ | title = prof. Edmund Puczyłowski (publications) | publisher = pbn.nauka.gov.pl | access-date = 14 July 2016}}</ref>

He died on 19 October 2021 and was buried in the Municipal Cemetery in Białystok.<ref>{{Citation |url = https://www.ptm.org.pl/zawartosc/zmar%C5%82-profesor-edmund-puczy%C5%82owski-1948-2021 |title = Prof. Edmund Puczyłowski Passed Away (1948–2021) |publisher = ptm.org.pl/ |language = pl |access-date = 6 April 2022}}</ref>
